subtitle: Out Cebu · Cebu Pacific
overview: Fly Cebu Pacific direct to Shanghai and stay four nights in 4★ hotels in Shanghai, Wuxi and Hangzhou. Day 2 is a free day (optional Disneyland or Jinmao Tower tour), then the tour visits the Bund, Wuxi’s Nianhua Bay Mini Kyoto night view, Nanxun Ancient Town with a boat ride, a stroll along West Lake, Meijiawu Tea Garden with a Hanfu experience and Zhang Garden, plus several shopping stops.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Cebu, Dec 8–13 2026 to Dec 8–13 2026. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

placeDesc.Chenghuang Temple: A Taoist temple in Shanghai's old city, beside the Yu Garden bazaar area.
placeDesc.Nanjing Road: Shanghai's best-known pedestrian shopping street, running toward the Bund.
placeDesc.The Bund: Shanghai's riverfront promenade, with historic buildings facing the modern Pudong skyline.
placeDesc.Oriental Pearl Tower: Shanghai's landmark TV tower in Pudong, seen from outside on this tour.
placeDesc.Nianhua Bay Scenic Spot (Mini Kyoto): A Japanese-inspired lakeside scenic area in Wuxi, visited for its night view.
placeDesc.Nanxun Ancient Town: A canal town in Zhejiang with old merchant houses; a boat ride is included.
placeDesc.West Lake: Hangzhou's famous lake, where the tour includes a stroll along the shore.
placeDesc.Meijiawu Tea Garden: A tea-growing village near Hangzhou where you can try a Hanfu costume.
placeDesc.Zhang Garden: A historic garden in Shanghai, the last sightseeing stop before the airport.
placeDesc.World’s largest Starbucks Flagship Store: A large Starbucks flagship store in Shanghai visited as a photo and coffee stop.
placeDesc.LV Mega Ship: A ship-shaped luxury-brand building by the Huangpu river in Shanghai, visited as a photo stop.
placeDesc.Shanghai Disneyland (optional): Disney theme park in Shanghai, offered as an optional full-day tour on the free day.
placeDesc.Jinmao Tower (optional): A skyscraper in Pudong with an observation hall on the 88th floor, in the optional tour.
placeDesc.Xintiandi (optional): A dining and shopping district built around restored Shikumen lane houses, in the optional tour.
placeDesc.Taobao underground market (optional): An underground shopping market visited as part of the optional city tour.
